easy.def: To bring things or people together.
easy.example: We gather sticks for the fire.

more.def: To collect things into one place, or to come together as a group.
more.example: The class gathered around the teacher to hear the story.

easy.example: It was generous of you to share your snack.

more.def: Willing to give time, money, or help to others freely.
more.example: Our generous neighbor gave vegetables from her garden to everyone on the street.

more.def: Kind, calm, and careful; not rough or strong.
more.example: A gentle rain fell on the garden all morning.
A gigantic balloon floated over the parade.

more.def: To look at something quickly and then look away.
more.example: She glanced at her watch to check the time.

easy.example: It is a gloomy, rainy day.

more.def: Dark and dull, or feeling sad and without hope.
more.example: The gloomy old house had not seen sunlight in years.

easy.def: To give off a soft light.
easy.example: My night-light glows in the dark.

more.def: To shine with a soft, steady light.
more.example: The campfire glowed long after the flames died down.

easy.def: Something you want to do and work hard for.
easy.example: My goal is to read ten books.

more.def: Something you are trying to reach or achieve.
more.example: Her goal is to learn to play the violin this year.

easy.example: I am grateful for my family.

more.def: Feeling or showing thanks for something good.
more.example: We were grateful to the neighbors who helped us move.

easy.def: What pulls things down to the ground.
easy.example: Gravity makes the ball fall down.

more.def: The force that pulls objects toward the Earth and keeps us on the ground.
more.example: Because of gravity, a dropped pencil always falls to the floor.

easy.example: The greedy boy took all the cookies.

more.def: Wanting much more of something than you need or than is fair.
more.example: The greedy king kept all the gold for himself.

easy.example: I am grumpy when I am tired.

more.def: Easily annoyed and in a bad mood.
more.example: He is always grumpy before he has eaten breakfast.

easy.def: To give an answer when you are not sure.
easy.example: Can you guess what is in the box?

more.def: To give an answer or opinion without knowing for certain.
more.example: I guessed that there were two hundred beans in the jar.

more.def: To lead or show the way to someone.
more.example: A ranger guided us along the trail to the waterfall.
